name: NLLLoss

input.description: Input tensor of shape (N, C) or (N, C, d1, d2, ...), expected to be log-probabilities. Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

target.description: Target tensor of shape (N,) or (N, d1, d2, ...), int64 with values in [0, C-1].

weight.description: Optional tensor of size C, manual rescaling weight per class. Same dtype as input. Omit if absent.

ignore_index.description: int, target value that is ignored. Default -100.

y.description: NLL loss value. Scalar if reduction in ('mean','sum'), same shape as input if 'none'.

description:
NLLLoss: Computes the negative log likelihood loss.

torch.nn.functional.nll_loss = nll_loss(input, target, weight=None, size_average=None, ignore_index=-100, reduce=None, reduction='mean') -> Tensor

Args:
    input: (N, C) where C = number of classes or (N, C, H, W) in case of 2D Loss, or (N, C, d_1, d_2, ..., d_K) where K >= 1 in the case of K-dimensional loss. input is expected to be log-probabilities.
    target: (N) where each value is 0 <= targets[i] <= C-1, or (N, d_1, d_2, ..., d_K) where K >= 1 for K-dimensional loss.
    weight (Tensor, optional): A manual rescaling weight given to each class. If given, has to be a Tensor of size C.
    size_average (bool, optional): Deprecated (see reduction).
    ignore_index (int, optional): Specifies a target value that is ignored and does not contribute to the input gradient. When size_average is True, the loss is averaged over non-ignored targets. Default: -100.
    reduce (bool, optional): Deprecated (see reduction).
    reduction (str, optional): Specifies the reduction to apply to the output: 'none' | 'mean' | 'sum'. Default: 'mean'.

Example:
    >>> input = torch.randn(3, 5, requires_grad=True)
    >>> target = torch.tensor([1, 0, 4])
    >>> output = F.nll_loss(F.log_softmax(input, dim=1), target)

Returns: Tensor, reduced loss value.
